messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

We need to compute first part: car starts from rest, 10 seconds, distance 120 m. We need final speed at end of this period. We can assume constant acceleration? The problem likely expects constant acceleration. So we can use kinematics: distance = v_initial * t + 0.5 * a * t^2. v_initial=0, t=10, distance=120. So 120 = 0.5 * a * 100 => 120 = 50 a => a = 120/50 = 2.4 m/s^2. Final speed v_final = v_initial + a * t = 0 + 2.4*10 = 24 m/s. So first part speed = 24 m/s.

Now second part: after reaching this speed (24 m/s), car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the initial speed? But then "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" would be wrong because first part speed is 24 m/s, double would be 48 m/s. So maybe the second stage initial speed is 12 m/s, final speed is twice that: 24 m/s. But then the final speed is not twice the first part speed. So maybe the phrase "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" refers to the final speed of second stage is twice the speed computed in first part. That would be 48 m/s. So maybe the second stage initial speed is 12 m/s, final speed is 48 m/s. That would be double the first part speed. That seems plausible: The car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, from 12 m/s to final speed which is twice the speed computed in first part. So final speed = 48 m/s. So we need to compute acceleration in second stage: a = (v_final - v_initial)/t = (48 - 12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2. So answer: first part speed 24 m/s, second stage acceleration 7.2 m/s^2.
